terminal_record.title: Unverified claim of a 2025 Gina Haspel leak investigation
terminal_record.description_short: The supplied record alleges a 2025 leak investigation targeting Gina Haspel; the packet does not verify that one was opened.
terminal_record.description_medium: The frozen record alleges that the Trump administration opened a classified-leak investigation of former CIA Director Gina Haspel in March 2025, framing it as retaliation. The packet provides no supporting source or case details. A July 2025 Federalist article discusses a proposal to investigate Haspel over Russia-related issues, but does not report the alleged March leak probe. This remains an internal, unverified allegation.
terminal_record.description_long: The frozen record alleges that the Trump administration opened a classified-leak investigation of former CIA Director Gina Haspel on March 20, 2025, over leaks said to have damaged President Trump. It frames the alleged inquiry as retaliation and says critics linked it to Haspel’s earlier handling of intelligence assessments and the Ukraine whistleblower matter. None of those asserted connections is established by the supplied packet: it identifies no agency announcement, case number, charge, named source, or contemporaneous report confirming that a leak investigation was opened. A July 28, 2025 Federalist article reports that Peter Schweizer raised questions about Haspel and argues in its headline that she should be investigated over Russia-related matters. That later commentary does not document a March leak inquiry, and its topic is distinct from the record’s alleged classified-leak probe. This draft preserves the supplied claim as an allegation for internal review. Its date and all attributed conduct remain unverified; do not present them as findings, charges, or proof of retaliation. Before publication, establish whether an official or credible report identifies a specific investigation and supports the claimed subject and date.
